title: Finisar FTLC1154RDPL QSFP28 100Gb/s 100GBASE-LR4 1310nm 10km SMF Optical Transceiver

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Boost your long-distance network performance with the Finisar FTLC1154RDPL 100GBASE-LR4 QSFP28 Optical Transceiver, now available at D CORE. This high-quality 100Gbps module is designed for 10km single-mode fiber (SMF) links, making it a perfect choice for modern data centers, enterprise core networks, cloud infrastructures, and telecom backbone systems.


Engineered with LAN-WDM 4-channel technology, the FTLC1154RDPL transmits and receives data across four wavelengths around 1310 nm, ensuring extremely stable, low-loss, and low-latency long-range connectivity. Its QSFP28 hot-pluggable design enables easy installation and compatibility with a wide range of switches, routers, and transmission equipment from major brands like Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Huawei, HP, and more.

This transceiver offers high reliability, excellent heat management, and Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DOM) for real-time optical health tracking—making it a trusted solution for mission-critical 100G networking environments.

Whether you're upgrading your data center uplinks, connecting multi-building campuses, or deploying high-speed backbone infrastructure, the Finisar FTLC1154RDPL delivers outstanding performance and long-term dependability.


Key Features

  • Supports 100GBASE-LR4 100Gb/s Ethernet
  • Long-distance 10 km transmission over SMF
  • Operates at 1310 nm, LAN-WDM 4-channel design
  • QSFP28 hot-pluggable form factor
  • Low power consumption
  • Supports Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM/DOM)
  • Fully compliant with IEEE 802.3ba & QSFP28 MSA
  • Compatible with Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Huawei, and more
  • Ideal for long-range data center, enterprise, and telecom applications
